title: Get a Walmart+ Subscription for $1 to Unlock Free Streaming, Free Shipping and Members-Only Discounts
summary: Attention, bargain shoppers: here's how to join Walmart+ for the lowest price yet.
contentText:

While Walmart has daily rollback deals online , one of the best ways to score a deeper discount at the department store is by signing up for Walmart+ . And there’s no better time to do it, as the retailer is offering a 30-day trial for just $1 for new users looking to try out the popular membership program.

While Walmart offers daily deals for everyone, a Walmart+ membership offers loads of benefits, exclusive perks and early access to sales before everyone else. The best part: the new $1 offer saves you a massive 92% off the regular monthly price of $12.95.

The $1 deal gets you a full month of access to all the Walmart+ perks. Choose to continue with a monthly or annual plan after you trial is up or cancel at anytime with no commitment.

How to Join Walmart+

Walmart+ is just $1 for 30 days right now and then costs $98 for the annual membership (about $8.17/month) or $12.95 for the monthly membership after the month-long trial is over.

LIMITED TIME DEAL

Walmart+ Annual Membership

$49 $98 50% off

However, you can currently save 50% off an annual membership, with Walmart discounting the subscription price to just $49. Lock in the price now and have access to Walmart+ for the entire year.

What Is Walmart+?

Walmart+ is Walmart’s subscription program, that unlocks instant access to a load of benefits, including shopping certain sales earlier than everyone else, special pricing and exclusive product releases. Members can enjoy free shipping with no order minimum, so you won’t have to worry about adding things to your cart that you might not even need just to get free shipping.

You can also claim a free subscription to either Peacock or Paramount+ . Users can choose between the two streaming services to watch your favorite blockbuster movies, hit TV shows and live events online without cable. As part of Walmart+, you can switch streamers after 90 days if you want, or just keep what you’ve got.

Walmart+ also features member-only offers such as a generous 10 cents/gallon off fuel at Exxon & Mobile stations, 25% off orders at Burger King, and up to 10% back in Walmart Cash on flights, hotels, car rentals and activities booked through Walmart+ Travel.

SEE WALMART+ PERKS AND BENEFITS

The membership also includes free grocery delivery, contact-free checkout with mobile-scan and go, travel deals and free pharmacy delivery too. And Walmart+ members get free flat tire repair and other auto care in addition to a host of other member benefits.

If you’re interested in a longer discount offer, you can join Walmart+ for an entire year for 50% off right now. This is a limited time deal so we recommend signing up while the offer is still live.

The retail giant also offers Walmart+ Assist discounted subscription pricing. The Walmart+ Assist discount is available to eligible new and existing Walmart+ members. Existing members who qualify for the price cut will receive a prorated refund and the discounted price will begin immediately, per Walmart . See if you quality for the discount here .

Does Walmart+ Have a Free Trial?

Walmart+ used to offer a 30-day free trial but that has been replaced by the $1 deal online . Still, it’s a tiny price to pay for the range of offers and benefits that members will be able to receive.

GET: WALMART+ 30-DAY TRIAL
